slot_scores.name: unknown_typeB_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether Type B equipment has a capacity limit; it only asked about fractional barrels and then assumed no Type B capacity limit in the final model.

slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about the objective function before READY_TO_MODEL; it silently assumed profit maximization in the final model.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Type B equipment has no stated capacity limit.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about Type B capacity and treated the absence of a stated limit as confirmation that none exists.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to maximize daily profit.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked to confirm the objective and proceeded directly to a profit-maximization model.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL after only one clarification question, leaving the P0 objective slot and P1 Type B capacity slot unresolved.

summary: The agent asked only about fractional processing and then stopped, silently assuming profit maximization and no Type B capacity limit. It missed both hidden slots, including the P0 objective, making the stop premature.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
